decisions.statement: The rows are read from beside the page of the command that ran.
Every command page is reached by walking the tree rather than by a folder named here.
A folder git or a package manager owns is walked past.
Every numbered file of a page's rows is read rather than the first alone.
A folder named as a rows file is no file to read.
A row a write left half appended is passed over and the rest of the file read.
The file that row is in is named beneath the table under its own heading.
A row naming the command phase is read and no other row is.
The row a change run wrote beside the same page counts nowhere here.
The runs are gathered under the command that ran.
A window is chosen by the rule the check measuring chooses one by.
The rows are drawn by the rule the check measuring draws its rows by.
A command's ceiling is the wall-clock seconds that command's page allows.
A command stating no seconds is drawn with the seconds the wrapper allows.
A command stating that it runs under no ceiling is drawn blank.

definition: what the runs of every command cost, read back over a window
